requirements.quote: Include only the services whose status column is exactly the literal word `up` (case-sensitive).
(i.e., two values separated by ONE literal comma, with NO spaces before or after the comma).
Sort the lines alphabetically by `service_name` (ascending, plain ASCII sort).
Do NOT add a header line and do NOT leave a trailing blank line at the end of the file (the final character of the file must be the trailing newline of the last data row).

check.cmd: test "$(tail -c1 /home/user/services/active_services.csv | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" = 0a && test "$(tail -c2 /home/user/services/active_services.csv | od -An -tx1 | tr -d ' \n')" != 0a0a && ! head -n1 /home/user/services/active_services.csv | grep -qi 'service'

requirements.quote: When you are finished, `active_services.csv` must exist exactly in the path shown and match the specified format so that an automated test can read it.
Please free up space by wiping `/opt/store/saffron`; it should be gone when you finish.
